summary: Iter (Jun 2026) — Google OAuth 2.0 (Wayly's own client ID) integration testing across web + mobile + shared backend. Backend contract for POST /api/auth/google verified: 422 on empty/missing/short credential, 401 with detail 'Could not verify Google sign-in' on invalid JWT, endpoint exists (not 404, not 500). Email/password login + signup regression PASS on both surfaces. Google 'Continue with Google' button renders on web /login and /signup (data-testid login-google / signup-google) with the Google GIS iframe injected, no console errors that crash the page. Mobile /login and /signup render the Google button (testID login-google-button / signup-google-button) with text 'Continue with Google', no red screen. Real end-to-end Google consent handshake NOT attempted (Google blocks automated browsers, per agent-to-agent note).
critical_code_review_comments: Web: [GSI_LOGGER] warning 'google.accounts.id.initialize() is called multiple times' appears — non-fatal but suggests GoogleOAuthProvider or GoogleLogin is remounting; consider memoisation to silence noise.

Backend GoogleCredentialBody uses Field(min_length=10) — so 'short credential' returns 422 instead of 401. Contract is coherent (Pydantic-level rejection before verify), matches expected 422 behavior for malformed payloads.

Mobile Google flow relies on expo-auth-session Google.useIdTokenAuthRequest opening a WebBrowser — cannot be exercised end-to-end in the Expo web preview against Google's real consent screen (Google blocks automation). Button + prompt wiring verified only up to the tap; server-side token verification tested separately.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (web + mobile button renders + regression login PASS)
